verdict.rationale: Moosend is an email marketing platform, so a per-contact engagement-history API is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack never mentions an API that returns a contact's sent, opened or clicked history. The only related items are dashboards and data insights inside the app, which are adjacent features and not API access to per-person activity.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read per-person engagement history — what was sent, opened, clicked — through the API for any contact
